posts.author: The Decoder
posts.text: Anthropic says it cut Claude reasoning token theft by up to 99% in fight against industrial-scale distillation. Anthropic says it has cut the extraction of Claude's internal reasoning tokens by 90 to 99 percent. The company links the large-scale distillation attacks to Chinese companies Zhipu and Moonshot, and has already banned tens of thousands of accounts.
